approach: x86 static recompilation of the Watcom-built GDIDREAM.EXE to C; SDL3 host for Win32, D3D11/OpenGL/WebGL 2 renderer
help: Play-testing the GPU renderer through the whole game
notes: Plays from images of your own two discs with CD music, through a launcher. Adds a GPU renderer beside the original software one, smooth motion (30 Hz step, interpolated display), keyboard and gamepad remapping, and a Develop mode that restores Cryo's own level editor and developer tools from the July 1997 demo. Windows is the tested platform; Linux runs; the browser build plays a demo.
